name: core-overlay
description: Experiment protocol section 13.17 supplement: 0050 buy-and-hold core plus the orthogonalized (v1) stock long-short overlay of section 13.19 supplement 2, with the short book under supplement 4's primary execution assumptions. Variant A funds the long leg from the remaining cash and a loan secured on the 0050 holding; variant B takes the market exposure from a long TX position on a cash margin instead. The long-short books, universe, execution layer, TX data and periods come from suite_config; nothing in that file is re-selected here.

splits.note: 1:4 split; the dataset's adjusted_close carries dividends only
